## Graduate lectures

This page collects graduate teaching materials, interactive Quarto presentations, and reproducible demonstrations.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
### Deep Learning for Sequential Data: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and LSTMs

This lecture introduces sequential learning, recurrent state updates, backpropagation through time, the vanishing-gradient problem, LSTM gates and memory, and model evaluation. The material includes mathematical examples, diagrams, R and Python code, and instructor notes.

[**Open RNN and LSTM slides**](slides/rnn-lstm/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
:::
